description: Unsigned transactions to open (or add to) a gAIX short from the wallet: approve the USDG deposit (when needed), then open, which borrows the gAIX and sells it through Goldstein's pool, the sale money joining the deposit. Goes through when the hook takes at most 2% and the sale brings at least 95% of gAIX's price; stops at the desk's room and at three quarters of the limit; waits while the desk is paused. The open needs a gas limit of at least 12,000,000 (its transaction carries gas). Simulated from the wallet.

amount.description: gAIX to short, as a decimal string, like "5"

deposit.description: USDG to deposit with it, as a decimal string, like "200"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: gaix_short_open
title: Prepare: short gAIX
